Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 71 minutes to cut 10 mm punch holes in sheet metal fed from a conveyor belt, with a stroke speed of 800 mm/min and die alignment within ±0.05 mm, converting the input sheet metal into a finished cut sheet metal product that exits on the conveyor belt.

The laser cutting operation is performed on a Laser Cutter for 47 minutes using a laser power of 1.5 kW, a cutting speed of 1200 mm/min, and nitrogen assist to cut sheet metal from a ConveyorBelt, resulting in cut sheet metal being transferred to a MobileRobot.

A planing operation is performed on a Planer for 52 minutes to reduce the surface of a milled part transferred from the ConveyorBelt, with a planing depth of 6 mm, a feed rate of 0.4 mm/rev, and a surface finish of Ra 3.2 μm, resulting in a planed part being transferred to a MobileRobot.

A wire electrical discharge machining operation is performed on a Wire EDM machine for 73 minutes using molybdenum wire with a pulse width of 50 ns, peak current of 15 A, and a cutting speed of 20 mm/min, transforming a shaped part carried by a mobile robot into a precision finished ground part that is then conveyed to a conveyor belt.

A broached component is hobbed on a Hobbing Machine for 42 minutes at a hobbing speed of 750 rpm and a feed rate of 0.12 mm/rev, following an involute 20° pressure angle gear profile, resulting in a hobbied gear that is conveyed to the ConveyorBelt.

A horizontal milling operation is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 99 minutes using a milling speed of 1000 rpm, following a contour milling path with 3-axis interpolation to achieve a surface finish of Ra 1.0 µm, starting with a milled part on a conveyor belt and ending with the finished machined component transferred to a mobile robot.

A helical gear with 32 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 5 minutes at a shaping speed of 350 rpm, starting from a broached component held by a MobileRobot and resulting in a shaped gear delivered to a ConveyorBelt.

A CNC Turning operation is performed on a CNC Turning Center for 72 minutes using an optimized CNC program for high precision and surface finish, with tool offsets measured from the datum point and a spindle speed of 1500 rpm, starting with a lathed part on a MobileRobot and ending with a finished machined component as a milledPart on a ConveyorBelt.

The grinding operation is performed on Grinding Machines using an Al2O3 abrasive wheel at 3000 rpm with a feed rate of 0.05 mm/rev, processing a planed part transported by a mobile robot for 43 minutes to produce a ground part that is then conveyed to the conveyor belt.

A drilling operation is performed on a Metal bar using a Drill Press for 27 minutes at a spindle speed of 1000 rpm, a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, and a drill size of 8 mm, resulting in a DrilledComponent being transferred to a MobileRobot.
